title: Filament Finance
tagline: A Dapp for managing personal finance, including scheduled streaming payments using NFT anchors.
description:
In the near future employers will pay salaries in cryptocurrency. Likewise, companies and organizations will accept crypto. People will store their cash in their own digital wallets and manage their investments themselves.

This project envisions making payments and investments from a personal wallet that streamlines the cash flow management.

We’ll prototype making a payment with money streaming using an anchor NFT with custom metadata.
how_its_made: This project specifies using ‘nft.storage’ (ipfs-filecoin) and Superfluid. To create a streaming payment on a specific date the app mints an NFT that acts as an anchor for the streaming money. The user can send the NFT to the payment recipient. Custom metadata stored on IPFS (along with a visual image) defines the parameters of the stream. [However this is purely a concept, there is no code to review.]
